# Section Label

`decorative/section-label` &middot; content-level &middot; category: decorative

## Purpose

A centered label flanked by a thin line on each side, to introduce a section.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Muted label with hairlines.
- **accent**: Accent-colored label and lines. Sets `color: @colors.accent`, `textColor: @colors.accent`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `color` | color | `"@colors.border"` |
| `textColor` | color | `"@colors.mutedText"` |
| `thickness` | length | `"1px"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Table cells and colors honored. | Fine. | Lines and label swap via dm-* classes where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('decorative/section-label', {
  "text": "New arrivals"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "decorative/section-label",
  "data": {
    "text": "New arrivals"
  }
}
```
